_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-05-12 09:30:42Z)**_

The error is `non-fast-forward`: remote `origin/main` has commits your local `main` does not.

Safe fix:
```bash
git pull --rebase origin main
# resolve conflicts if prompted
git push origin main
```

If you want to inspect first:
```bash
git fetch origin
git log --oneline --graph --decorate HEAD..origin/main
```

Only use this if you intentionally want to overwrite the remote branch:
```bash
git push --force-with-lease origin main
```
